mapper.select: SELECT id AS itemId, product_id AS productId, product_code AS productCode, product_name AS productName, specification AS specification, unit AS unit, quantity AS quantity, unit_price AS unitPrice, warehouse_id AS warehouseId FROM erp_sale_order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY line_no ASC
SELECT id FROM erp_product_kit WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND COALESCE(active, FALSE) = TRUE AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id AS itemId, component_product_id AS productId, component_product_code AS productCode, component_product_name AS productName, component_product_spec AS specification, component_product_unit AS unit, quantity AS quantity FROM erp_product_kit_item WHERE kit_id = #{kitId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY line_no ASC
SELECT order_no FROM erp_sale_order WHERE id = #{orderId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT warehouse_id FROM erp_sale_order WHERE id = #{orderId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM erp_purchase_order WHERE source_bill_no = #{sourceBillNo} AND deleted = 0 AND status < 4
